title: Vault Equipment Register: Safe Deposit Box Dimensions and Installed Sizes
content:
Safe Deposit Boxes are leased in six sizes, each box the same depth and distinguished by the opening at its door. The interior measurements below are the measurements of the box itself, in inches.

## Interior measurements

| Size | Interior height | Interior width | Interior depth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 3 inches | 5 inches | 24 inches |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 3 inches | 10 inches | 24 inches |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 5 inches | 10 inches | 24 inches |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 inches | 10 inches | 24 inches |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 10 inches | 15 inches | 24 inches |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 10 inches | 20 inches | 24 inches |

Every size is 24 inches deep; only the height and the width of the door opening differ between one size and the next.

## Sizes installed, by branch vault

A size is either installed in a branch's vault or it is not. The register below records, for each of the six vaults, whether that size is installed there.

| Size | Greensboro Main Office | Winston-Salem Reynolda Road | Charlotte SouthPark | Raleigh North Hills | Greenville Main Street | Roanoke Market Square |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | installed | installed | not installed |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | installed | installed | installed | not installed | not installed | not installed |

The same register read the other way round, vault by vault: Greensboro Main Office, Winston-Salem Reynolda Road and Charlotte SouthPark each hold all six sizes; Raleigh North Hills and Greenville Main Street each hold five, the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box being absent from both; Roanoke Market Square holds four, neither the 10x15 nor the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box being installed there.

It follows from the register that the four smallest sizes are installed in every one of the six vaults, that the 10x15 Safe Deposit Box is installed in five of them, and that the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box is installed in three.

## Custody of the box

For every size, the box door opens only when the bank's guard key and the lessee's own key are both used; neither key opens the door alone.

For every size, the contents of a box are not insured by the bank.
